job.title: Commercial Manager
job.description:
A well-established and growing organisation based in Clayton is seeking an experienced Commercial Manager to partner with operational and executive leaders, driving financial performance, strategic decision-making and business growth. This is a highly visible role offering the opportunity to influence key business outcomes through commercial analysis, planning, business partnering and performance improvement initiatives.
Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will provide commercial insight and financial leadership to support profitability, operational efficiency and long-term growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Partner with senior leadership to drive commercial performance and strategic decision-making.
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes.
  • Deliver robust financial and commercial analysis to identify opportunities, risks and performance trends.
  • Evaluate customer, product and project profitability to support business decisions.
  • Develop financial models, business cases and investment appraisals.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and provide actionable recommendations to improve business outcomes.
  • Support commercial negotiations, pricing initiatives and contract reviews.
  • Partner with operational and sales teams to improve profitability and efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement across reporting, systems and processes.
  • Prepare reporting and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Ensure strong financial governance, controls and risk management practices are maintained.
About You
  • CA/CPA qualified.
  • Degree qualified in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience in Commercial Finance, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering or Commercial Management roles.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to influence and challenge stakeholders.
  • Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills.
  • Experience supporting operational and commercial decision-making within a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Proactive, solutions-focused and able to work autonomously.
What's on Offer
  • Permanent opportunity with a successful and growing organisation.
  • Clayton-based role with flexible working arrangements.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers.
  • Broad commercial scope with the ability to influence business performance.
  • Opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives and future growth.
Ideal Background This role would suit a Finance Business Partner, Senior Commercial Analyst, FP&A Manager or Commercial Finance Manager looking for a broader role with greater commercial influence and exposure to senior stakeholders.
 
How to Apply
Please click 'Apply' to submit your resume online, or contact Olivia Reiber on oreiber@quinnallan.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Finance Planning & Analysis Lead
job.description:
About the Company
Medical Indemnity Protection Society (MIPS) is a member-focused organisation providing protection, advice and support to healthcare professionals across Australia.
The organisation is entering an important period of transformation, with continued investment in systems, data and broader business capability. Finance is central to this journey, with an increasing focus on stronger business partnering, better management information and sharper commercial insight. This is an exciting opportunity to join an evolving finance function and help shape how MIPS measures performance and supports decision-making across the organisation.
  

About the Role
Reporting to the Financial Controller, the Financial Planning and Analysis Lead (FP&A Lead) will take ownership of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, KPI reporting and performance analysis, while partnering closely with executives and senior leaders across the business.
The role will focus on understanding the drivers of performance, providing meaningful commercial insight and helping stakeholders make better-informed decisions. You will work closely with leaders across MIPS to constructively challenge thinking, strengthen financial understanding and further establish finance as a valued business partner.
A key part of the opportunity is to modernise planning and reporting processes, reduce manual activity and explore how automation, AI and emerging technology can improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of financial information.


You will be responsible for:
  • Lead the budgeting and forecasting process across the organisation
  • Deliver meaningful management reporting, KPI analysis and performance insights
  • Partner with executives and senior stakeholders to support commercial and strategic decision-making
  • Translate complex financial information into clear, practical insights for non-finance stakeholders
  • Identify trends, risks and opportunities across financial and non-financial performance
  • Improve financial planning, reporting and analysis processes
  • Support the organisation's broader transformation agenda
  • Identify opportunities to use automation, AI and technology to streamline finance processes and reporting
  • Lead, coach and develop two direct reports.

About You
You are a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys partnering with the business and using financial information to influence better decisions. Naturally curious and confident engaging with senior leaders, you are comfortable asking questions, constructively challenging thinking and translating complex financial information into clear, practical insights.


You will bring:
  • Strong FP&A experience across budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and financial analysis
  • Proven ability to partner with and influence senior stakeholders
  • Experience within insurance, financial services or another regulated environment
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn financial data into meaningful business insights
  • A track record of improving reporting, financial processes and ways of working
  • Leadership, coaching or mentoring experience, with an interest in developing team capability
  • A degree in Accounting, Commerce or Business
  • CPA, CA or similar qualification.
This role offers genuine career progression for someone with the capability and ambition to develop into broader finance leadership responsibilities over time.


Next Steps
Please submit your application today by clicking 'Apply' or contact Rachel Morton on 0429 070 743 for further information.

job.title: Risk and Quality Manager - Health
job.description:
If Risk and Quality are your areas of specialisation within health or community and a new role is in your sights, review this!

The Organisation
This organisation plays a critical role in strengthening primary care, improving access to services and driving integration across the health system.  With a particular focus on equity, population health outcomes and innovation, their aim is to deliver impact with measurable goals that produce better health outcomes for communities.

The Role
This is a newly created leadership role that will steward best practice for Risk and Quality across the organisation.
Working closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation, your remit is to lead their key pillars, strengthen organisational controls and frameworks ensuring all leaders receive credible information for informed decisions.

This role will lead continuous improvement for risk management, governance and reporting, quality management, internal audits  and assurance and policy governance.  There will be a review of insurances where you will be the liaison with external negotiations, you will support all audit cycles with external providers including all planning, coordination and progress reporting.  This position will oversee incident and feedback reporting processes including complaints and improvement suggestions and also lead the development, review and implementation of the organisational policies and procedures.
Responsibility will also include leading implementation and continuous improvement for ISO9001.
This is a highly visible role with many touchpoints throughout the organisation.  As such it is critical that the successful candidate models the desired culture and demonstrates leadership through role modelling and delivery of work practices.

The Fit
The ideal candidate will possess the necessary qualifications that reflect best practice in risk and quality.  Post graduate quals are preferred.  Combining quals with significant experience, ideally gained in a similar sector where there is an appreciation of the nuances of health and not for profit would be preferred, demonstrated experience working with senior stakeholders is non-negotiable.  Experience working with a ticketing system, ISO27001 ISMS and exposure to Ai is ideal, systems literate, solutions focused, able to negotiate and influence with high level communications is expected.  Salary commensurate with experience, circa $155k plus super and SP.

What's Next
If this role speaks to your experience and desire to make a move to a new and exciting opportunity, please apply addressing key requirements as per this profile.  Forward your interest for the attention of Karen O'Brien, Partner with Quinn Allan
